title: You Only Prompt Once: On the Capabilities of Prompt Learning on Large Language Models to Tackle Toxic Content

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance (F1-score, accuracy, precision, recall) of large language models using prompt tuning on three downstream tasks: toxicity classification, toxic span detection, and text detoxification using standard hate speech datasets like HateXplain, HateCheck, MHS, ToxicSpan, and ParaDetox.
Measuring toxicity classification capabilities on the Social Bias Inference Corpus (SBIC), which focuses on offensive posts reflecting social biases collected from various Web communities.
Evaluating toxicity classification performance on the USElectionHate20 dataset, which specifically targets hateful or offensive tweets directed at politicians and election-related hashtags.
